problems.name: queries returning 0 rows due to incorrect join/filter logic; no verification step to catch and fix empty results

attempts.what: Add a second policy call that verifies the first draft by executing it; if it returns 0 rows unexpectedly, ask the model to diagnose and revise. Also enhance system prompt with explicit warnings about NULL-safe NOT IN patterns and checking join key consistency.

Broaden the verification step in solve.py: instead of only revising on empty/error results, always run a second policy call when the draft returns >0 rows. Feed the model its draft SQL plus actual sample output rows and ask it to validate column count/order, literal value form...
